title: "Shore Beats Work" in Inlet Beach | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Shore Beats Work" in Inlet Beach | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Shore Beats Work” - your 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom home in Inlet Beach LOCATION: “Shore Beats Work” is located in the beautiful Grande Pointe neighborhood - a prime location, less than a mile from the renowned 30A corridor and within easy reach of the beach. Discover the trails and history of Camp Helen State Park which boarders the community, and enjoy Lake Powell from the community dock and pool. You'll find both the tranquility of the surroundings and the convenience of nearby amenities. The upscale shopping and dining at 30Avenue are within close proximity, while familiar grocery stores and entertainment options at Pier Park are just a short drive away. The Panama City Airport (ECP) is only a 20-minute drive from the property. The newly-constructed underpass at the corner of the 30A and Highway 98 has now officially opened, allowing easy bike/pedestrian access to the beach. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: With over 3,000 sq. ft of living space, the home's layout is thoughtfully and spaciously distributed. The first floor bunk room is found at the rear of the home, featuring a private entrance to the backyard area. It also boasts a comfortable living room-style space with two flat-screen TVs and a seating area ideal for board games. A full bathroom (with a shower/tub combo) is conveniently located in the hall, allowing younger guests to have their own space without needing to venture upstairs. The second floor’s clean and bright living room space offers comfortable couches and chairs for the entire group, accompanied by a large smart TV as well as access to the fully screened-in 2nd floor balcony. The living room flows into the dining and kitchen area, which is equipped with top-of-the-line fixtures and appliances, including a stainless steel fridge/freezer, five-burner gas range, dishwasher, microwave, dual coffee maker, oven, toaster, and blender. All your culinary needs are catered for with a comprehensive selection of cookware, bakeware, and crockery. The dining area comfortably seats eight, accompanied by the kitchen island nook that also provides for seating for two. Just off from the kitchen is the powder room and a large laundry room, equipped with a full-size washer and dryer along with plenty of cupboard space. The third floor hosts the main sleeping area, comprised of three private bedrooms - a large owner suite with a king bed and private en suite with a walk-in shower and separate bathtub, another full-size king bedroom, as well as a queen bedroom with desk space for remote work. The third floor hallway bathroom across the landing comes with a shower/tub combo. The backyard area includes a large built-in fire pit, as well as a gas grill and outdoor seating. AMENITIES: The home comes with four adult bikes, beach gear, a stroller, towels (excluding beach towels), fresh linens, cutlery, cooking utensils, and a private driveway and garage that together can accommodate up to three cars. We offer a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities: Body Wash Shampoo Conditioner Hand Soap Toilet Paper Facial Tissues Dish Soap Dishwasher Pods Laundry Detergent Paper Towels Trash Bags Dish Sponge Bath towels Bed linens NOTE: This home has a security camera located outside above the garage The primary guest must be 25 or older to rent this home. Unless you have specifically arranged for an early arrival time, please do not arrive at the property before your scheduled check-in time. Do not hang towels on porch/balcony railings. The HOA imposed fines on guests found to be doing so. This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized occupancy of pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of all rents and deposits, and the guest will be responsible for any and all direct consequential damages. This home is strictly non-smoking. Construction - This neighborhood - along with many others along the 30A - is growing, and as such there may be construction with attendant noise that may take place during your stay. By booking this listing, you acknowledge that possible construction noise won't be an issue for you and that you understand that no discounts or refunds will be given for this reason. CONTACT: Need anything during your stay? Coast’s management team will assist you with anything you need. Just give us a call!

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
